title: Normalized fraction predicate for scalar-extension twist isomorphisms
statement: For a graded ring map psi:A→B, a scheme map r:Proj(B)→Proj(A), and a family theta_j:r*O_A(j)≅O_B(j), define the transported section by applying theta_j to the actual pullback section 1 tensor s [def-pc-module-pullback, def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. The normalization says: whenever a in A_i, b in A_k, i=k+j, U⊆D_+(b), and b*s=a pointwise, then for every coefficient c on r inverse U the value of c*theta_j(1 tensor s), multiplied by psi(b), equals c*psi(a). This is a predicate on given isomorphisms, not a chosen construction.
